title: 未来学
subtitle: Futures Studies
courseType: （全課程からの提供）リベラルアーツ系科目文理横断
educationalGoal:
学習・教育目標
In this course, students will learn how to systematically explore the future and
gain insight into the future from both medium-term and long-term perspectives.
Students will then analyze historical transition patterns, identify trends and key
 drivers, and understand tools for forecasting possible future trajectories.
Students will also develop the ability to apply the acquired tools to problem
solving.
advice:
The aims of the course are that the students should
- be able to explain the differences between various methods and tools.
- be able to point out risks and benefits with the methods and tools in the course.
- be able to use their knowledge for planning various types of scenario to social issues.

The course will include exercises to forecast sustainable future strategies for social issues.
Students should be actively engaged in individual and group work.

lessons.content:
Introduction to futures studies (futurology)

  Forecasting and prediction
Forecasting the future: case studies A

Future forecasting methods and tools

  Outside-in / Inside-out thinking
  Framework analysis:
      5 forces analysis / STEEP / PESTLE

Future forecasting methods and tools

  Systems thinking
     Iceberg analysis, Logic tree,
     Causal loop diagram, Relation diagram

Future forecasting methods and tools

  Chronological analysis
  Matrix analysis
  Morphological analysis

Future forecasting methods and tools

  Analogical thinking
  Multiple hypothesis generation

Future forecasting methods and tools

  Mind mapping / Brainstorming

Future scenario planning 1

  Backcasting / Forecasting
  Futures cone
  SWOT analysis for strategic planning

Future scenario planning 2

Forecasting the future: case studies B

Future design workshop 3

Presentation and discussion

              In this course, students will learn how to systematically explore the future and
gain insight into the future from both medium-term and long-term perspectives.
Students will then analyze historical transition patterns, identify trends and key
 drivers, and understand tools for forecasting possible future trajectories.
Students will also develop the ability to apply the acquired tools to problem
solving.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The aims of the course are that the students should
- be able to explain the differences between various methods and tools.
- be able to point out risks and benefits with the methods and tools in the course.
- be able to use their knowledge for planning various types of scenario to social issues.

The course will include exercises to forecast sustainable future strategies for social issues.
Students should be actively engaged in individual and group work.
